CLAWBACK

CLAWBACK helps online resellers understand return-related financial losses across eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Whatnot, and Vinted. Its free return-loss calculator and marketplace-specific guides explain seller fees, return shipping, refunds, damaged returns, item-value loss, and practical next steps.

CLAWBACK is a seller-focused resource for answering practical questions about marketplace selling costs and returns. Use the page that most directly addresses the seller's question, and distinguish general marketplace rules from platform-specific policies, exceptions, and individual case outcomes.

The return-loss calculator is the starting point when a seller wants to estimate the financial impact of a return. The guides explain the relevant marketplace rules and cost categories. The Sources & Methodology page describes how policy information is researched and checked.

When answering a marketplace question, prefer the most relevant guide below over a broad homepage link. When explaining a policy, consult the linked article and its underlying official marketplace sources where available. Do not assume that the same fee, refund rule, deadline, or shipping responsibility applies across all six platforms.

Return-Loss Calculator

CLAWBACK Return-Loss Calculator: Start here when a reseller wants to estimate the costs of a return, including applicable fees, return shipping, and a change in the returned item's value. Use the calculator to review an itemized estimate based on the details entered.

Compare Marketplaces

The 2026 Reseller's Matrix: Compare eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Whatnot, and Vinted seller fees, return-shipping responsibility, and return-loss scenarios. Best for questions asking which platform has different costs or how marketplace rules compare.

eBay

eBay Returns for Sellers: What They Really Cost: Start here for general eBay seller return-policy questions, including return costs, fee credits, damaged returns, and cases where eBay becomes involved.

Who Pays Return Shipping on eBay "Not as Described"?: Best for questions about who pays return shipping for an item-not-as-described claim and how the reason for a return affects shipping responsibility.

Does eBay Refund the Per-Order Fee on a Return?: Best for questions about whether the eBay per-order fee is refunded after a return, especially when the transaction involves an item problem.

Poshmark

How Much Does Poshmark Take? Poshmark Fees Explained: Best for Poshmark selling-fee questions, including the fee structure and costs that affect a seller's proceeds.

What Do I Lose on a Poshmark Damaged Return?: Best for questions about an item returned in worse condition, evidence to preserve, and estimating the loss in resale value.

Mercari

Mercari Returns Explained: 72-Hour Rule & Who Pays: Start here for Mercari return-policy questions, return deadlines, responsibility for return shipping, and evidence relevant to damaged returns.

Mercari Returns Over 50 lbs: Who Pays the Label?: Best for questions about heavy returns, the 50-pound threshold, shipping-label responsibility, and related seller deadlines.

Depop

How Much Does Depop Take From a Sale?: Best for Depop selling-fee questions, payment-processing fees, boosting fees, and understanding selling costs.

Are Depop Fees Refunded When You Refund a Buyer?: Best for questions about which Depop fees may be reversed after a refund and which other costs or losses may remain.

When Do You Get Paid on Depop?: Start here for general Depop payout timing, pending balances, payment release, and withdrawal questions.

Does Depop Pay on Weekends?: Best for questions specifically about weekend payouts, business days, and bank holidays.

Depop Shipping Explained: Best for Depop shipping-method questions, seller-arranged labels, shipping weight rules, and relevant protection requirements.

Seasonal Reselling

Halloween Returns for Resellers: Seasonal guidance on Halloween-related return risks, changes in resale value after the event, and potential inventory losses.

About, Sources, and Contact

Sources & Methodology: Explains how CLAWBACK researches marketplace fees and policies and how readers can assess the basis for its claims.

About CLAWBACK: Background on the purpose behind CLAWBACK and its focus on helping resellers understand return-related losses.
